source: Dung (1995) reinstatement; research/PITFALLS.md Pitfall 17 (a deep chain is where an off-by-one traversal fails silently)
description: a four-deep linear chain of direct attacks, a attacks b attacks c attacks d, with no cycle anywhere in it
reasoning: a is unattacked and holds; b is defeated by a and fails; c's only attacker, b, is itself defeated, so c is reinstated and holds; d is defeated by the now-in c and fails — the alternation has to reach four levels deep correctly, not just the two levels a shallow fixture would exercise
